title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00062 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
11:45 - 12:00: Performed TBT for skidding rig to well f-14
12:00 - 13:30: Skidded cantilever to well f-14 removed hatch. Built scaffolding in moonpool installed hole covers on well f-15. Meanwhile r/u return hoses.
13:30 - 14:30: Pulled master bushing and lowered nt2 connector down to multibowl. Installed nt2 connector to multibowl. Changed to BX-ELEVATOR.
14:30 - 15:45: P/u cutter BHA. B/o and r/b handling pup and pup joint.
15:45 - 16:15: P/u and m/u multibowl RT. RIH and engaged RT to multibowl. Confirmed by taking 20 ton overpull.
16:15 - 16:30: Performed TBT for r/d tension cylinders
16:30 - 19:00: Load shifted weight to TDS. R/d tension cylinders.
19:00 - 19:15: Performed TBT for r/d boat collision stool
19:15 - 20:00: R/d boat collision stool and centralizer
20:00 - 20:30: Increased flow rate in steps to 2300 LPM 82 bar. Cut riser at 134,9m
20:30 - 21:30: R/d hoses and valve outlets from multibowl.
21:30 - 22:00: Pulled riser and inner string to drill floor. Removed master bushing and installed c-plate.
22:00 - 22:15: B/o multibowl RT and parked same in aft PRS. Rigged up false rotary.
22:15 - 22:45: Pulled inner string. R/b cutter BHA.
22:45 - 23:00: M/u multibowl RT and removed c-plate.
23:00 - 23:45: Pulled multibowl and tensioner joint. Stopped every meter to clean off marine growth on centralizer deck. Installed master bushing and elevator. Landed off riser onto elevator.
23:45 - 00:00: R/u cutting machine started cutting tensioner joint.
